note: Both sets are accurate against the page, with no misread or invented values. Set A captures the filter symbol definitions (y, u, α, n, Ts, fc) and the blade-pitch controller scope, but omits the important operational-range facts (torque controller below-rated, pitch controller above-rated) and the two-basic-control-systems statement. Set B covers those substantive facts plus the conventional design approach, though it includes one redundant restatement of the nonpower-production control actions claim and adds a somewhat loose 'baseline control system' condition on the filter-type claim. Because B keeps the key operating-range and design-approach facts that A misses, while A's extra claims are mostly trivial symbol definitions, B is the better set.
